gaps.sentence: His ___ (SHORT) of funds forced him to abandon the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Shortage of funds' — the noun for an insufficient amount.
'Arrived damaged' — participle describing the state of the parcel.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the Queen caused a stir.
The shop is under new ___ (MANAGE) from Monday.
Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.

gaps.sentence: He's a regular ___ (CONTRIBUTE) to the magazine.
He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.
